verdict.rationale: Orb documents a public API in depth: an API reference covering idempotency, cursor-based pagination, typed error responses and cached responses, plus concrete endpoints for subscription creation, usage-event ingestion and alert creation. It also ships official SDKs in six languages, real-time webhooks and an llms.txt index for AI consumption. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
